Ahaziah asked a foreign god instead of the God of Israel. Where do people look for answers instead of God?
The third captain humbly pleaded for mercy. How does humility change our approach to God?
Elisha would not leave Elijah. What does faithful devotion look like?
Elisha asked for a double portion of Elijah's spirit. What would you ask God for in your service?
Elisha asked, "Where is the Lord, the God of Elijah?" How do you find God when a mentor is gone?
Elisha healed the water at Jericho. How does God bring healing to broken places?
The kings asked God's help when they ran out of water. How does need drive us to God?
God said, "This is a light thing in the sight of the Lord." What seems impossible to you but easy for God?
The widow's oil kept flowing as long as she had jars. What could you bring to God for him to fill?
The Shunammite woman made a room for Elisha. How can you show hospitality to God's servants?
She said, "All is well," and went to the man of God. Where do you take your crisis?
A little bread fed a hundred men, with some left over. How does this point to Jesus?
A young servant girl pointed Naaman to the prophet. How can you point others to God?
Naaman was angry at the simple instruction to wash. Why do we resist God's simple ways?
Naaman said, "Now I know there is no God in all the earth but in Israel." What has convinced you of God?
Gehazi's greed led to lies and judgement. How does greed lead us astray?
Elisha made the axe head float. What does this show about God caring for small things?
Elisha prayed, "Lord, open his eyes." What do you need God to open your eyes to?
Elisha fed his enemies instead of killing them. How can you show kindness to an enemy?
The officer doubted God's word. How does unbelief limit us?
The lepers said, "This is a day of good news... we are not doing right" to keep silent. Who could you share good news with?
God's word came true exactly. How does this build trust in God's promises?
God restored the Shunammite woman's land. How has God restored what you lost?
Elisha wept as he foresaw the evil Hazael would do. What does Elisha's grief show?
God did not destroy Judah for David's sake. How does God's faithfulness to his promises protect us?
Jehu was anointed to bring judgement on Ahab's house. What does this show about God's justice?
Jezebel's end fulfilled God's word. What does this show about God's word?
Jehu asked Jehonadab, "Is your heart true to my heart?" What does a true heart look like?
Jehu removed Baal worship but did not walk in God's law with all his heart. Why is partial devotion dangerous?
Jehosheba hid the baby Joash to save David's line. How does God protect his promises through courageous people?
Jehoiada made a covenant that they should be the Lord's people. What does it mean to be the Lord's?
Joash did right all the days Jehoiada instructed him. How do godly mentors shape us?
The people gave to repair the house of the Lord. How can you give to support God's work?
Elisha told the king to strike the ground, but he stopped at three. Where might you be half-hearted with God?
A dead man touched Elisha's bones and lived. What does this show about God's power over death?
The Lord was gracious to them because of his covenant. How does God's covenant love hold you?
Amaziah obeyed the law about not punishing children for parents' sins. What does this show about God's justice?
Amaziah's pride led to defeat. How does pride lead to downfall?
Azariah did right, yet the high places were not taken away. What small compromises remain in your life?
King after king was assassinated in Israel. What does this chaos show about life without God?
Ahaz did not do what was right and even copied pagan practices. How can we be influenced by the culture around us?
Ahaz rearranged the temple to please a foreign king. How can fear of others reshape our worship?
Israel fell because they sinned against the Lord and did not listen. What does this show about God's patience and judgement?
God warned them through every prophet: "Turn from your evil ways." How does God warn us today?
They feared the Lord but also served their own gods. Where might you divide your loyalty?
Hezekiah trusted in the Lord, and there was none like him. What does trusting God look like for you?
The Assyrian asked, "On what do you rest this trust of yours?" How would you answer?
The enemy mocked God's power to save. How do you respond when your faith is mocked?
Hezekiah tore his clothes and went to the house of the Lord. Where do you go in a crisis?
Hezekiah spread the letter before the Lord and prayed. What can you spread before the Lord?
God answered and defended the city. How has God answered your prayers?
God said, "I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears." What does this show about God?
The shadow went back ten steps. What does this show about God's power?
Hezekiah showed off his treasures. How can pride creep in after blessing?
Manasseh led the people into terrible evil. How can one person's influence lead many astray?
God warned of judgement through the prophets. What does this show about God's patience?
When the book of the law was found and read, Josiah tore his clothes. How do you respond to God's word?
Because Josiah's heart was tender and humble, God heard him. What does a tender heart look like?
Josiah made a covenant to follow the Lord with all his heart. What would it look like for you to make that commitment?
Josiah removed every idol. What idol needs to be removed in your life?
Josiah kept the Passover and turned to the Lord with all his heart. What makes Josiah stand out?
Judah fell because of sin, as God had warned. What does this show about God's word?
The king and leaders were taken into exile. What does exile show about the cost of sin?
Jerusalem fell and the temple burned. How do you hold on to God when everything seems lost?
Jehoiachin was released and given a place at the king's table. What hope does this ending give?
